SEMANTIC_CONTRACT.classification: BINDING. Frozen from the parent without change. Every clause below is a narrowing or a verbatim restatement, never a new decision.

SC-1_entitlement_is_not_authorization.rule: An EntitlementGrant answers: is this capability commercially or administratively granted to this Organization, and at what limit? It NEVER answers: may this subject perform this action?
SC-1_entitlement_is_not_authorization.structural_consequence: Authorization remains membership x role and is evaluated by a DIFFERENT code path. The two predicates MUST NOT be merged into one function, one query or one return value. A single call that answers both is a violation of this clause even if both of its answers are individually correct.

SC-2_scope.rule: The effective key is Organization x capability_key. Never CommercialAccount x capability_key, and never subject x capability_key.
SC-2_scope.parent_basis: ENTITLEMENT_GRANT.effective_key; ENTITLEMENT_GRANT.prohibitions[3]: 'Is NOT keyed by CommercialAccount. A grant is always Organization-scoped even when its basis is commercial -- this is what makes CA-08 no pooled quota structurally true rather than merely intended.'
SC-2_scope.structural_consequence: commercial_account_id is present on the row as PROVENANCE (the commercial basis), never as the key. No unique constraint, no index and no evaluator input may treat it as the scope.

SC-3_explicit_organization_evaluator.rule: The evaluator takes an EXPLICIT organization_id argument. It must NEVER resolve the Organization from an ambient principal, from a selected-first membership, from user_single_active_membership, or from any implicit tenant derived from an arbitrary membership.
SC-3_explicit_organization_evaluator.parent_basis: MIGRATION_DAG.nodes[CE-3].compatibility; parent manifest P-8; MULTIORG_INTERSECTION vs S3 and vs S7.
SC-3_explicit_organization_evaluator.why_it_is_load_bearing_quoted_from_paren: S7 removes the index that today makes 'the caller's single active membership' well-defined. Every entitlement read that resolves an Organization implicitly rather than explicitly breaks silently at S7 -- it does not fail, it evaluates the wrong tenant.
SC-3_explicit_organization_evaluator.structural_consequence: Explicitness is itself the assertion. An evaluator whose signature permits omitting the organization is non-conformant even if every current call site passes one.

SC-4_commercial_account_is_never_tenant_.rule: A CommercialAccount MUST NEVER become selected tenant scope. No commercial identifier is ever set as a database GUC, is ever part of the request principal, or is ever a term in an RLS predicate over tenant data.
SC-4_commercial_account_is_never_tenant_.ce3_specific_reading: CE-3 adds a relation that CARRIES commercial_account_id. That makes CE-3 the first node at which a 'convenience' join from commercial basis to tenant visibility becomes writable. The prohibition is therefore restated here and made assertable by companion control CE3-N-11.

SC-5_exactly_one_live_row.rule: Exactly one LIVE row per (organization_id, capability_key), enforced by a PARTIAL UNIQUE mechanism whose predicate is WHERE effective_to IS NULL.
SC-5_exactly_one_live_row.parent_basis: ENTITLEMENT_GRANT.effective_key; target_shape.constraints[6]; MUT-2; parent manifest N-6 and M-2; PG-4.

SC-6_append_only_lifecycle.rule: Rows are INSERTed and CLOSED only. Closing means setting effective_to from NULL to a timestamp EXACTLY ONCE. No other UPDATE of any column. No DELETE of any row.
SC-6_append_only_lifecycle.parent_basis: ENTITLEMENT_GRANT.target_shape.append_only_rule (verbatim: 'Rows are INSERTed and CLOSED (effective_to set once, from NULL to a timestamp). No other UPDATE and no DELETE.'); SEC-12.
SC-6_append_only_lifecycle.revocation: Revocation is closing the live row, optionally followed by INSERTing a replacement. It is never an UPDATE of the live row's limit, source or basis.
SC-6_append_only_lifecycle.no_status_column: A 'status' column is DELIBERATELY ABSENT and its introduction is PROHIBITED. State derives from the effective period, so that a row cannot be simultaneously closed and active. Parent clause quoted: 'A status column is deliberately ABSENT: status is derived from the effective period, so a row cannot be simultaneously closed and active.'

SC-7_source_vocabulary.rule: Exactly these four values, spelled exactly this way. No fifth value, no synonym, no lowercase variant.

SC-8_commercial_provenance_constraint.rule: commercial_account_id IS NOT NULL when source IN ('PLAN','COMMERCIAL_EXCEPTION'); commercial_account_id IS NULL when source IN ('PLATFORM_ADMIN','BOOTSTRAP_DEFAULT').
SC-8_commercial_provenance_constraint.biconditional_note: The parent states BOTH directions as separate CHECKs, and both are BINDING. Implementing only the first would admit a PLATFORM_ADMIN grant carrying a commercial basis that never existed -- the exact fabrication parent manifest P-17 forbids for SENTINEL_MANUAL_QUOTA_ORG. Since the source set is closed at four, the two CHECKs together are a biconditional; an implementation MUST NOT collapse them into one and MUST NOT weaken either into a nullable-permissive form.
SC-8_commercial_provenance_constraint.parent_override_check: Searched the frozen parent for any clause saying otherwise. None exists. The mission directive's 'unless the frozen parent says otherwise' escape is therefore NOT triggered.

SC-9_limit_vocabulary.rule: limit_kind IN ('UNMETERED','BLOCKED','CAPPED'), exactly three values. CAPPED requires limit_value NOT NULL AND limit_value >= 0. UNMETERED and BLOCKED require limit_value IS NULL.
SC-9_limit_vocabulary.parent_basis: ENTITLEMENT_GRANT.target_shape.columns[6],[7] and constraints[0],[1]; MUT-4; parent manifest N-8 and M-4.
SC-9_limit_vocabulary.why_a_discriminator_quoted_from_parent: The legacy column overloads NULL to mean 'unlimited'. Carrying that overload into a generic grant table would silently make every future capability unlimited-by-default the moment someone forgot to set a value. limit_kind makes the three states explicit and makes 'nobody decided yet' impossible to express as 'unlimited'.
SC-9_limit_vocabulary.null_semantic_prohibition_restated: The Stella semantic (null = unlimited, 0 = blocked) is RETAINED FOR THE STELLA CAPABILITY ONLY and is NOT a general rule. CE-3 MUST NOT infer, for any other capability, that an absent limit means unlimited. Each capability's metered semantic is declared explicitly in the capability catalogue, and a capability with no declared semantic FAILS CLOSED.

SC-10_effective_period_invariant.rule: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > effective_from. Strict inequality; an equal pair is REFUSED.

SC-11_plan_ref_is_a_snapshot.rule: plan_ref is a SNAPSHOT string, NOT a live foreign key into a plan catalogue. Editing a plan definition must never retroactively rewrite what an Organization was granted.
SC-11_plan_ref_is_a_snapshot.structural_consequence: A CE-3 implementation MUST NOT add an FK from plan_ref to any plans/catalogue relation, now or later, and MUST NOT resolve plan_ref through a join at evaluation time.

SC-12_cross_organization_fails_closed.rule: Asking for the effective entitlement of an Organization the caller is not scoped to is REFUSED with an explicit failure code. It is NEVER answered with an empty result set, NEVER with the caller's own Organization's entitlement, and NEVER with the first visible Organization's entitlement.
SC-12_cross_organization_fails_closed.parent_note_quoted: The distinction matters: an empty result and a refusal are indistinguishable to a test that asserts on absence, which is why the companion manifest asserts on the failure code.

DERIVED_ordering_consequence.derivation: SEC-6 requires a REFUSAL. Row-level security produces an EMPTY SET, never a refusal: a policy that does not match filters the row away silently. Therefore the cross-organization guard MUST be an explicit check that fires BEFORE any row-visibility outcome can be observed, and MUST NOT be left to RLS filtering. An implementation whose cross-organization behaviour is 'the policy returns no rows' satisfies neither SEC-6 nor parent manifest N-1, and is non-conformant even though its observable row count is the same as a correct implementation's.
DERIVED_ordering_consequence.why_it_must_be_said_here: This is the single most plausible way a competent implementer lands a CE-3 that passes an absence-based test and still violates SEC-6. The parent states the requirement; this authority states the mechanism it forecloses.

rules: Membership does NOT imply entitlement. An organization_admin of an Organization with no live grant for a capability is REFUSED that capability, and the refusal is attributable to the MISSING GRANT, not to the role. (SEC-4, parent manifest N-2.)
Entitlement does NOT grant membership. A live grant for (OrgA, capability) gives a subject with no membership in OrgA no role, no membership and no tenant read in OrgA. (SEC-3, parent manifest N-3.)

A plan does NOT grant authorization and does not grant an entitlement. There is no read path from plan state to effective limit without an intervening grant row. (PLAN_ENTITLEMENT_BOUNDARY; SEC-5, whose enforcement point is CE-5 but whose structural precondition -- that a grant row is the only such path -- is created here.)

entitlement_grants references organization_members not at all, references no role value, and references no subject other than the RECORDING actor (actor_user_id).
entitlement_grants is not keyed by CommercialAccount.

SC-14_ungoverned_is_not_permissive.rule: organizations.commercial_account_id IS NULL means no CommercialAccount governs this Organization. It does NOT mean free, unlimited or trial. Entitlement in that state comes ONLY from grants whose source is BOOTSTRAP_DEFAULT or PLATFORM_ADMIN.
SC-14_ungoverned_is_not_permissive.ce3_consequence: The evaluator MUST return NO LIVE GRANT for an ungoverned Organization with no grant row. An implementation that special-cases NULL governance as a permissive default violates CA-05 through the back door. Made assertable by companion control CE3-N-10 against SENTINEL_UNGOVERNED_ORG.

SC-15_no_trigger_from_commercial_state_t.rule: A database trigger on commercial_accounts that writes entitlement_grants is PROHIBITED OUTRIGHT.
SC-15_no_trigger_from_commercial_state_t.parent_basis: PLAN_ENTITLEMENT_BOUNDARY.prohibited_shortcut, verbatim: 'It would recreate CC-3 in a new location: a commercial write silently becoming a runtime capability change, with no separate audit and no refusal point.'
SC-15_no_trigger_from_commercial_state_t.ce3_consequence: CE-3 creates the relation such a trigger would target. The prohibition therefore binds CE-3's own migration: the CE-3 diff must contain no trigger, rule or foreign-key action that causes a write to commercial_accounts to produce a row in, or a change to, entitlement_grants.

PHYSICAL_TARGET_SHAPE.classification: NARROWED FROM ENTITLEMENT_GRANT.target_shape. The thirteen columns below are ENUMERATED FROM THE PARENT ARTIFACT at AS_OF_HEAD, not recalled: ENTITLEMENT_GRANT.target_shape.columns is a thirteen-element array and each element is quoted verbatim in parent_declaration_verbatim.
PHYSICAL_TARGET_SHAPE.provenance_sufficiency_quoted_from_paren: The column set above is the MINIMUM that answers, for any grant, at any past instant: what capability, for which Organization, from what source, on whose commercial basis, under which plan identity, with what limit, over what period, for what stated reason, by which actor, with which audit row. An implementing node may add columns; it may not remove one of these and claim provenance.
PHYSICAL_TARGET_SHAPE.addition_rule: An implementing node MAY add columns beyond these thirteen. It MUST NOT remove, rename or weaken the nullability of any of them, and any added column must not reintroduce a derived 'status' (SC-6) or a live plan FK (SC-11).

classification_legend.FUTURE_MEASUREMENT_REQUIRED: Cannot be settled from frozen authority at AS_OF_HEAD. The implementing mission must measure or probe it and record the result; it fails closed until then.

fk_on_delete_rule.BINDING_prohibition: ON DELETE CASCADE is PROHIBITED on organization_id, commercial_account_id and actor_user_id. Derivation: SC-6 freezes 'no DELETE' of any grant row, and SEC-12 requires that history remain reconstructible from append-only rows. A cascading delete is a DELETE of grant rows performed by the database on behalf of an unrelated statement, which destroys exactly the rows SEC-12 requires to survive. ON DELETE SET NULL is likewise PROHIBITED on organization_id (NOT NULL) and would silently erase provenance on the other two.
fk_on_delete_rule.IMPLEMENTATION_DEFINED_choice: The specific non-destructive action -- RESTRICT or NO ACTION -- is the implementer's choice. Measured precedent at AS_OF_HEAD: db/schema.ts:83 uses onDelete 'restrict' for organizations.commercial_account_id, landed by CE-1.
fk_on_delete_rule.note: This is a derivation from two named parent clauses plus a measurement, not a new decision. It is recorded as BINDING only in its PROHIBITIVE half.

RLS_SECURITY_CONTRACT.classification: EXECUTABLE_SECURITY_POSTURE derived from parent SEC-3, SEC-4, SEC-6, SEC-12, MULTIORG_INTERSECTION (S4) and PG-7. Derived FRESH for CE-3; NOT copied from CE-1 or from L1.
RLS_SECURITY_CONTRACT.why_not_mechanical_reuse: CE-1's posture (ENABLE + FORCE + ZERO policies) is correct for a relation NOTHING READS. CE-3's relation MUST BE READ -- the node's own deliverable is 'effective entitlement read at Organization x capability'. Copying CE-1's posture would produce a relation the evaluator cannot read. L1's posture (ENABLE + FORCE + a member SELECT policy + a conjunctive INSERT policy over current_user_role_in_org) is correct for TENANT DATA written by a tenant subject. An entitlement grant is neither: it is tenant-ADJACENT provenance written by a commercial or platform act, and its read must fail CLOSED cross-organization rather than filter silently. Neither sibling's policy set is transferable.
frozen_BINDING: CREATE TABLE entitlement_grants is followed, in the SAME migration, by ALTER TABLE entitlement_grants ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY.
ALTER TABLE entitlement_grants FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY is likewise required in the same migration.

No tenant role, and no commercial identifier, is ever added to an RLS predicate over TENANT data as a consequence of this node (SC-4 / MUT-10). db/identity-context.ts is NOT in CE-3's touches and stays out of its diff.
The cross-organization refusal is NOT delegated to RLS. See SEMANTIC_CONTRACT.SC-12.DERIVED_ordering_consequence -- an RLS filter produces an empty set, which SEC-6 rejects.
No policy, grant or role created by CE-3 may confer membership, a role, or any tenant read beyond entitlement_grants itself (SC-13).

No super-admin bypass is invented by CE-3, and no role hierarchy is inferred by CE-3. If a platform read of entitlement_grants is needed, it belongs to CE-8 under the platform predicate that tenancy S5 reshapes -- not here.

enable_and_force_derivation.measurement_at_AS_OF_HEAD: Census over db/migrations/**.sql and db/baseline/**/*.sql: 53 relations carry ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; 52 of them carry at least one CREATE POLICY; exactly ONE carries zero policies, and that one is commercial_accounts. Exactly THREE relations carry FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, and all three are the newest relations in the corpus: account_legal_acceptances (CL-1), commercial_accounts (CE-1) and organization_commercial_acceptances (L1).
enable_and_force_derivation.derivation: ENABLE is required because a relation without RLS is PERMISSIVE by default, which fails open -- the wrong direction for a relation carrying commercial provenance. FORCE is required because it is the measured convention of every relation added to this corpus since CL-1, and because without it the table owner is exempt, which would make any policy CE-3 or a successor writes silently inert for a migration or application role that happens to own the table.

POLICY_SET.classification: FUTURE_MEASUREMENT_REQUIRED -- and this is CE-3's single unresolved security decision.
POLICY_SET.why_unresolved: The parent orders it: MULTIORG_INTERSECTION vs S4 states that entitlement_grants 'and commercial_account_organization_history are new tenant-adjacent relations and need RLS decided under the SAME conjunctive model S4 freezes', with ordering 'S4 BEFORE the RLS of the new relations is finalised. A relation whose policies were written under the pre-S4 model would have to be re-derived.' Tenancy S4 is NOT integrated at AS_OF_HEAD.
POLICY_SET.the_tension_stated_plainly: ENABLE + FORCE + zero policies denies every ordinary role, INCLUDING the evaluator, so CE-3's own deliverable would be unreadable. Authoring a tenant-facing policy now is ordered after S4. These two facts are both true and the node cannot satisfy both by copying a sibling. The decision is therefore named here, fail-closed, rather than guessed.
admissible_resolutions_measured: R-A -- A NON-tenant-facing read path: the evaluator is a SECURITY DEFINER function owned by a role for which a single narrow policy (or a BYPASSRLS posture) is granted on entitlement_grants, with NO policy addressed to any tenant role. This defers every tenant-facing policy decision to S4 while making the node's deliverable readable. Measured feasibility: db/migrations/** already creates SECURITY DEFINER functions in nine units (0032, 0060..0065, 0072) and already raises explicit SQLSTATEs via RAISE ... USING ERRCODE (0030, 0060, 0070), so this resolution needs no db/prepared/** capability unit and stays inside CE-3's frozen touches.

R-B -- Land the relation with ENABLE + FORCE + ZERO policies and defer the ENTIRE read path to a successor node after S4. Admissible only if the node's deliverable is re-scoped by a parent amendment, because the parent's CE-3 delivers the read. This authority does NOT perform that re-scoping and does not authorize it.
R-C -- Author the tenant-facing policy set now, before S4. PROHIBITED by MULTIORG_INTERSECTION's explicit ordering. Recorded so that it is refused by name rather than merely unlisted.
POLICY_SET.obligation_on_the_implementation_opening: The CE-3 implementation opening MUST resolve this to exactly one of R-A or R-B, MUST record which parent clause authorizes the choice, and MUST prove the resulting posture on a disposable cluster with the probe named in REAL_PG_NODE_CONTRACT.PG-CE3-TENANT-ISOLATION. Proceeding without that resolution FAILS CLOSED. This authority's preference, recorded as a RECOMMENDATION and not an adjudication, is R-A, because it is the only one of the three that delivers the parent's CE-3 without either re-scoping the node or pre-empting S4.

application_and_capability_identity_expe.rule: The identity that reads entitlement_grants, the identity that writes a grant, and the tenant-facing runtime identity MUST be distinguishable, and the write identity must not be reachable from a tenant request path. Which concrete roles those are depends on the POLICY_SET resolution above and on the platform-admin ACL set (parent F-1), neither of which this authority adjudicates.
application_and_capability_identity_expe.never_assume: FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY is SILENTLY INERT for a BYPASSRLS role and for the table owner. Any claim that a role is denied must be measured on a cluster AS that role, never inferred from the migration text. This is CE-1's own PG-3 lesson, restated because it applies with full force to a table that DOES have policies as much as to one that does not.

RLS_SECURITY_CONTRACT.cross_org_refusal: BINDING -- SC-12. Asserted on the FAILURE CODE, never on absence. PG-7 is the mandatory runtime proof.

append_only_mutation_restriction.rule: The storage boundary must REFUSE any UPDATE other than the single NULL -> timestamp transition of effective_to, and must refuse every DELETE.
append_only_mutation_restriction.measured_mechanisms_available: db/migrations/0030_immutability.sql defines uellix_forbid_mutation() and RAISEs with ERRCODE 'insufficient_privilege'; L1's 0072 reuses it as an append-only trigger guard. A CE-3 implementation reusing that function is following measured precedent. Whether the guard is a trigger, a policy, a revoked privilege or a combination is IMPLEMENTATION_DEFINED; that it exists AT THE STORAGE BOUNDARY rather than only inside a verb body is BINDING -- parent manifest N-12 makes exactly this distinction for the sibling history relation.
append_only_mutation_restriction.note: The parent's SENTINEL_CLOSED_HISTORY_ROW proves this for CE-2's relation. CE-3 has no history relation, so the companion manifest introduces a node-local analogue, SENTINEL_CLOSED_GRANT_ROW.

RLS_SECURITY_CONTRACT.separation_of_membership_and_entitlement: BINDING -- SC-13. entitlement_grants references organization_members not at all. No policy on entitlement_grants may be written in terms of a ROLE value, because a role-conditioned read would make the relation's visibility an authorization statement, which is the merge SC-1 forbids.

No trigger from commercial_accounts to entitlement_grants (SC-15).

EVALUATOR_CONTRACT.classification: BINDING where the parent binds it; IMPLEMENTATION_DEFINED for encoding and placement within the frozen touches.

inputs.organization_id: REQUIRED and EXPLICIT -- BINDING (SC-3). The signature must make it impossible to call the evaluator without naming an Organization.
inputs.capability_key: REQUIRED -- BINDING. Derived directly from ENTITLEMENT_GRANT.effective_key ('Organization x product-capability') and from parent manifest P-8 ('answers at the Organization x product-capability boundary'). An evaluator keyed on Organization alone cannot answer the parent's question.
inputs.evaluation_instant: IMPLEMENTATION_DEFINED whether it is an explicit parameter or the transaction instant. See evaluation_instant_semantics.

evaluation_instant_semantics.classification: FUTURE_MEASUREMENT_REQUIRED -- an explicit decision the implementer must make and prove.
evaluation_instant_semantics.the_two_notions: (1) The DATABASE key: LIVE is defined by the parent as effective_to IS NULL, unconditionally, and the partial unique index carries no effective_from term. (2) The EVALUATOR's answer: 'what is in force at instant T'. These coincide for every row whose effective_from is in the past, and DIVERGE for a row whose effective_to is NULL and whose effective_from is in the FUTURE -- which CHECK-5 permits.
evaluation_instant_semantics.binding_part: The uniqueness key is effective_to IS NULL and MUST NOT be narrowed to add an effective_from term -- doing so would permit two rows the parent's SC-5 forbids.
evaluation_instant_semantics.decision_required: Whether the evaluator additionally requires effective_from <= instant before reporting a grant as in force. The implementer MUST decide this explicitly, state it, and cover it with a control. It MUST NOT be left to emerge from whichever comparison the query happens to contain.
evaluation_instant_semantics.fail_closed_default: Absent an explicit decision, the node fails closed. This authority does not pick for the implementer, because the parent binds neither reading and picking one here would convert an implementation choice into an authority decision.

output_shape.classification: The DISTINCTIONS are BINDING; the ENCODING is IMPLEMENTATION_DEFINED.
BINDING_distinguishable_outcomes: NO_LIVE_GRANT -- there is no live row for (organization_id, capability_key). This is an ANSWER, not a refusal, and not an error.
BLOCKED -- a live row exists with limit_kind BLOCKED. The capability is affirmatively denied by an entitlement decision.
CAPPED -- a live row exists with limit_kind CAPPED, carrying limit_value.
UNMETERED -- a live row exists with limit_kind UNMETERED.
REFUSED -- the request itself is refused, e.g. a cross-organization request (SC-12) or an undeclared capability_key (SC-9). This is NOT an answer about entitlement.
conflation_prohibitions: NO_LIVE_GRANT and REFUSED MUST be distinguishable. Absence and refusal are different facts; SEC-6's whole point is that collapsing them makes an absence-based test unable to see a cross-tenant leak.
NO_LIVE_GRANT and BLOCKED MUST be distinguishable. 'Nobody decided' is not 'decided against', and collapsing them reintroduces the null-semantic overload SC-9 exists to prevent.
UNMETERED and CAPPED-with-a-large-value MUST be distinguishable (PI-2, restated at the evaluator boundary).
output_shape.measured_constraint_on_reuse: lib/capabilities/contracts.ts already defines a CLOSED outcome vocabulary for CAP-01..CAP-05 (succeeded / idempotent / denied / contended / unavailable, over SQLSTATEs U0001/U0002/U0003). That module states of itself that it is owned by the CAPABILITIES workstream, that PRODUCT and RELEASE consume it and neither modifies it, and that every change there is a contract change going through docs/ops/contracts/. CE-3 therefore MUST NOT edit contracts.ts to add an entitlement outcome. Whether CE-3's evaluator defines its own outcome type in a NEW file under lib/capabilities/** or opens a contract change is IMPLEMENTATION_DEFINED; editing contracts.ts inside a CE-3 implementation diff without that contract change is a STOP. See OPEN_FINDINGS F-CE3-2.

purity.BINDING: The evaluator MUTATES NOTHING. It writes no row, sets no GUC, creates no audit entry as a side effect of being asked, and does not lazily materialise a missing grant.
purity.derivation: SC-6 restricts writes to INSERT and the single close; PLAN_ENTITLEMENT_BOUNDARY forbids a plan read producing an effective limit without an intervening, separately audited grant write. An evaluator that created a grant on a cache miss would be exactly that forbidden path.

entitlement_is_not_authorization_at_the_.BINDING: A valid grant does NOT prove user authorization. The evaluator's return value MUST NOT be usable, on its own, as an authorization decision, and no caller may treat UNMETERED or CAPPED as permission for a subject to act.
entitlement_is_not_authorization_at_the_.enforcement: Because nothing may consume the evaluator before CE-4 (ENFORCEMENT_BOUNDARY_CE4), this clause is enforced at CE-3 by the absence of consumers, and becomes a live integration constraint at CE-4.

placement.BINDING: Within CE-3's frozen touches: db/schema.ts, db/migrations/** and lib/capabilities/**. No other directory.
placement.IMPLEMENTATION_DEFINED: Whether the evaluator is (a) a SQL SECURITY DEFINER function created in the CE-3 migration with a thin typed wrapper in lib/capabilities/**, or (b) a TypeScript-only reader in lib/capabilities/** over the relation. The choice is constrained, not free: PG-7 requires a REFUSAL observable as a SQLSTATE at the database boundary, and the RLS POLICY_SET resolution R-A presumes a definer. An implementer choosing (b) must show how PG-7's SQLSTATE requirement is met without one.
placement.measured_feasibility_of_(a): db/migrations/** creates SECURITY DEFINER functions in nine units at AS_OF_HEAD and raises explicit ERRCODEs in at least three, so (a) requires no db/prepared/** capability unit and no widening of CE-3's touches.

CONCURRENCY_CONTRACT.final_authority: THE DATABASE. The PARTIAL UNIQUE INDEX on (organization_id, capability_key) WHERE effective_to IS NULL is the sole and final mechanism ensuring exactly one live row per effective key.
CONCURRENCY_CONTRACT.parent_basis: ENTITLEMENT_GRANT.effective_key; MUT-2; PG-4 ('the partial unique index actually refuses a second live grant under concurrent inserts', why_runtime: 'Partial-index/NULL interaction under concurrency').

proof_obligation.BINDING: A CE-3 implementation must prove CONCURRENCY, not merely sequential duplicate refusal.
proof_obligation.required_shape: TWO CONCURRENT transactions attempt to create a LIVE grant for the SAME effective key. EXACTLY ONE commits. The other is REFUSED BY THE DATABASE INVARIANT -- a unique-violation from the partial index -- and not by an application pre-check.
proof_obligation.why_sequential_is_insufficient: A sequential second insert is refused by any correct implementation, including one whose only guard is an application-side SELECT-then-INSERT. That guard is precisely what a concurrent pair defeats, so a sequential test cannot distinguish a correct implementation from the defective one MUT-2 describes.
proof_obligation.additional_shape: The same pair must also be proven for the CLOSE-then-INSERT sequence: closing the live row and inserting its replacement must not transiently admit two live rows, nor leave zero where one was expected.

application_side_locks.rule: This authority does NOT require an advisory lock, a row lock or any application-side serialization for CE-3. The parent requires none for this node: its per-organization advisory lock (PI-3) belongs to the quota LEDGER and its compare-and-set row lock (MUT-6) belongs to CE-2's transfer. Adding one to CE-3 is IMPLEMENTATION_DEFINED and may not be used as a SUBSTITUTE for the partial unique index.
application_side_locks.prohibition: An implementation that relies on an application lock INSTEAD of the database constraint is non-conformant, because dropping the index -- parent mutation M-2 -- would then not be caught.

REAL_PG_NODE_CONTRACT.classification: NODE-SPECIFIC materialization of the parent REAL_PG_FUTURE_CONTRACT. MANDATORY before CE-3 may close.
REAL_PG_NODE_CONTRACT.no_postgres_in_this_mission: This authority runs no container, no cluster and no probe. It compiles the contract only. Zero Docker, zero PostgreSQL, zero network.
REAL_PG_NODE_CONTRACT.rule_quoted_from_parent: These properties are RUNTIME properties of PostgreSQL -- policy combination, definer GUC resolution, NULL-not-TRUE denial, concurrency serialization, constraint interaction. Static reading of SQL text is NOT proof for any of them.

harness.cluster: DISPOSABLE ONLY, via the repository's disposable-audit path (measured at AS_OF_HEAD: tests/postgres/disposable-db.ts, driven by scripts/db-audit-disposable.ts, gated on UELLIX_PG_TESTS=1). NEVER staging, NEVER production, NEVER the canonical local stack.
harness.fixture: TWO CommercialAccounts and THREE Organizations: account X governing OrgA and OrgB, account Y governing OrgC. BINDING -- the parent states that a single-account fixture cannot express CA-02 and therefore cannot falsify SEC-7 or SEC-8.
harness.fixture_addition_for_CE3: SENTINEL_UNGOVERNED_ORG requires an Organization whose commercial_account_id IS NULL. Whether that is a FOURTH Organization or OrgC re-purposed is IMPLEMENTATION_DEFINED, but the ungoverned state must be present in the fixture, because SC-14 is otherwise unfalsifiable.
harness.canary_requirement: The non-scoped Organizations must carry REAL rows, including real entitlement_grants rows. A probe that returns zero rows merely for want of data proves nothing.
harness.separate_login_identities: BINDING. The probes below distinguish a tenant-facing runtime role from the migration/owner role. They MUST be executed under separate logins. A probe run as the table owner cannot test FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY at all, and a probe run as a BYPASSRLS role cannot test RLS at all -- both roles' BYPASSRLS and ownership status must be ASSERTED, not assumed.
harness.anti_skip: A probe that cannot run because the gate is off must be reported SKIPPED, never silently passed. A harness whose setup fails must fail the gate, not initialise to a value that reads as success.

inherited_parent_probes.proves: MUT-2 -- the partial unique index actually refuses a second live grant under concurrent inserts.
inherited_parent_probes.shape: See CONCURRENCY_CONTRACT.proof_obligation. Two concurrent transactions, same effective key, exactly one commits, the loser refused by the DATABASE.

inherited_parent_probes.proves: SEC-6 -- a cross-organization entitlement request raises the refusal SQLSTATE rather than returning an empty set.
inherited_parent_probes.why_runtime_quoted: Fail-closed versus empty-result is indistinguishable at the type level.
inherited_parent_probes.shape: A principal scoped to OrgA asks for OrgC's entitlement. The observable outcome must be a RAISED SQLSTATE. A zero-row result FAILS this probe even though a naive assertion on emptiness would pass.

node_local_future_probes.proves: SEC-3 -- a live grant for (OrgA, capability) confers no membership, no role and no tenant read in OrgA on a subject who is not a member. Measured as a row-count delta on organization_members across the grant insert (zero) plus a scoped read attempt by the non-member (denied).

SEC-4 -- an organization_admin of an Organization with NO live grant is refused the capability, and the refusal is attributable to the MISSING GRANT rather than to the role. The fixture must hold the admin role so that a role-based explanation is actively excluded, not merely absent.

A principal scoped to OrgA observes no entitlement_grants row of OrgB -- where OrgA and OrgB are governed by the SAME CommercialAccount X -- and SENTINEL_SIBLING_ORG_CANARY_ROW planted as an OrgB grant is absent from every result set, log line and error payload. This is also the probe that VERIFIES whichever RLS_SECURITY_CONTRACT.POLICY_SET resolution the implementation opening chose.

Append-only close-only behaviour AT THE STORAGE BOUNDARY: the single NULL -> timestamp UPDATE of effective_to succeeds once; a SECOND close of the same row is refused; an UPDATE of any other column is refused; a DELETE of any row is refused. Asserted against SENTINEL_CLOSED_GRANT_ROW.

SC-7 and SC-8 in the database: a fifth source value is refused; source PLAN with commercial_account_id NULL is refused; source PLATFORM_ADMIN with a non-NULL commercial_account_id is refused. Both directions of the biconditional, because implementing only one admits a fabricated commercial basis.

SC-9 in the database: limit_kind CAPPED with limit_value NULL refused; CAPPED with limit_value < 0 refused; UNMETERED or BLOCKED with a non-NULL limit_value refused; a fourth limit_kind value refused.
SC-10 in the database: effective_to equal to effective_from is refused (strict inequality), and effective_to earlier than effective_from is refused.

SC-3 at runtime: the evaluator answers for the Organization NAMED IN THE ARGUMENT and not for any Organization derivable from the connection's ambient state. Proven by asking, from a principal whose ambient membership is OrgA, for OrgB where the caller IS scoped to OrgB, and observing OrgB's answer -- so that an implementation silently substituting the ambient Organization is caught returning OrgA's.

ENFORCEMENT_BOUNDARY_CE4 at the database boundary: no trigger, rule, view, policy, default or foreign-key action anywhere in the corpus causes entitlement_grants to be read by, or to alter the behaviour of, any pre-existing runtime path. Complements the static control CE3-N-9, which cannot see a trigger.
SC-14 -- SENTINEL_UNGOVERNED_ORG, whose commercial_account_id IS NULL and which holds no grant row, yields NO_LIVE_GRANT and never an implicit permissive answer.

Each node-local control that derives from a parent control NAMES that parent id inside its own description, so the inheritance is explicit and one-directional. why_a_node_manifest_is_needed_at_all: The parent manifest is a BATCH commitment over CE-1..CE-9 whose postgres_requirements leave both harness paths UNKNOWN for the batch as a whole. CE-3 needs a node-level real-PostgreSQL contract with node-specific probes; the batch document cannot carry twelve CE-3 probes without becoming a CE-3 document.

CE-3 has node-specific obligations the batch manifest does not express at all: the ENFORCEMENT_BOUNDARY_CE4 controls, the append-only storage-boundary control for a relation that has no history sibling, the source/limit/effective-period validation controls, and the evaluation-instant decision.

The mission that authored this authority was directed to produce one, and a node execution authority whose test contract lives only in a batch document cannot be independently certified at node granularity.

two_vacuities_found_and_closed.rule: The battery's first run produced TWO GREEN results where RED was expected. Both were real defects in this mission's own checkers and BOTH were fixed rather than reported as passes. They are recorded because a battery that only ever reports success is itself the thing it exists to detect.

V-1.mutation: M02 -- removing one required negative control (CE3-N-1).
V-1.cause: The only floor on control removal was the schema's minItems 1, which a manifest stripped to a single control still satisfies. The authority named some node control ids in prose but did not DECLARE a closed required set, so nothing could detect the removal of one it had not happened to mention.
V-1.fix: Added REQUIRED_NODE_CONTROLS to this authority: a closed, exhaustive, bidirectional list of the 28 control ids the companion manifest must carry, checked in BOTH directions (no required control missing, and no undeclared control present).

V-2.mutation: M08 -- dropping the runtime CE-4 probe requirement from postgres_requirements.rationale.
V-2.cause: The check searched the WHOLE manifest document for the probe identifier. The identifier also occurs incidentally inside mutation control CE3-M-5's own description, so the search was satisfied by a different occurrence than the one the mutation removed. This is the self-satisfying-search defect: a document-wide containment assertion cannot fail while any copy of the literal survives anywhere.
V-2.fix: Scoped the assertion to postgres_requirements.rationale -- the field that actually carries the requirement -- rather than to the document.

items: The SEMANTIC adequacy of the frozen CE-3 contract is NOT self-certified by any mutation here. A mutation battery can prove a checker discriminates; it cannot prove the contract is the right contract. That judgement belongs to the independent certification lane.

No control here can prove a FUTURE implementation's behaviour. Every control of the companion manifest is a COMMITMENT about tests that do not yet exist, and its non-vacuity can only be demonstrated by the implementing mission, on a real cluster, against real code.

The checkers used are purpose-written for this mission and live in a scratch directory; they are NOT repository gates and this authority does not claim they are. No repository test validates a test manifest against UELLIX_TEST_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_v1.0.0 at AS_OF_HEAD -- scripts/ods-controller.ts only lists the schema path as immutable-by-convention, it does not consume it. That absence is recorded as an observation about the repository, not as a claim about this package.
